title: Tech Note: Hard Disk Browser Example Database

historical_commentary.text: This note showcases new 4D v6 commands for examining and manipulating hard disk files/directories via the HDBrowse example database, alongside hierarchical list creation and a recursive method example; while recursion and hierarchical list UI concepts remain evergreen programming techniques, the specific v6-era file-system commands and hierarchical list APIs demonstrated have been superseded by 4D's modern file-system and list-handling command sets.
related_updates: 4D's file-system access commands and hierarchical list APIs have been substantially expanded and modernized since this v6-era example (e.g. modern folder/file object commands, newer list management commands)
Recursive method design itself remains a standard, still-relevant programming technique independent of the specific era-bound commands used to demonstrate it here
